testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-signed-in.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23079 disabled sales rep cannot sign in and enabled sales rep can

scenario.summary: The admin disables a sales rep's account; the sales rep cannot sign in to admin or webstore. The admin enables it again; the sales rep signs in to both.
steps: Open the sales rep's (@rep.userName) management page; click Disable Account; Save and Close.
Sign in as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password) on the admin URL and on the webstore: both refused with the OOB message.
Re-open the management page; click Enable Account; Save and Close.
Sign in as the sales rep on admin and webstore: both succeed.
stateChanges: The sales rep is disabled, then enabled again (deleted at teardown).
assertions: Disabled: admin and webstore sign-in refused with the OOB message
Enabled: admin and webstore sign-in succeed
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': enabled and unlocked can sign in to admin and webstore; disabled or locked cannot.
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (analysis answer 2).
The OOB refusal message is not fixed by the FSD (read from the page).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
The enabled rep signs in to the webstore of its own store (storeA.webstoreDomain), not the suite's default WEB_BASE_URL, which points to another environment (user decision 2026-11-19).
